title: Full-Stack Flutter Developer - Cladbe
description: About CladbeIndia sold over ₹6 lakh crore of new homes in its top seven cities, and much of it still runs on spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads and tools never built for real estate. Cladbe is building the operating system a real-estate developer runs the whole business on: every enquiry, site visit, booking, payment schedule and handover in one place. It connects to property.new, our marketplace built to show buyers every RERA-registered project in a city, checked and current.We're building toward commercial launch and hiring a Full-Stack Flutter Developer to join our core engineering team and build features end to end, from the screen to the API behind it.Where you'll work: for the first few months, the core team builds together in Bareilly. After that, the whole team moves to Noida, where the role is based.What you'll doBuild our platform in Flutter across web and mobile, from first screen to release.Turn complex real-estate workflows into screens that are fast and simple to use, on a desktop in a sales office or a phone at a site.Write the backend your features need: Node.js and TypeScript services and the APIs behind them.Model data in PostgreSQL that stays correct when many people work on the same records at once.Keep every screen in step with live data, and keep the app usable on a weak connection: cached data, queued actions, and a clear sign when something is still syncing.Own quality end to end: performance, releases and tests.The stackFlutter and Dart, for web and mobileNode.js and TypeScript, on PostgreSQLMust haveFlutter and Dart in production, including Flutter WebState management with Riverpod or BLoCNode.js and TypeScript: you've built APIs, not just called themPostgreSQL: schema design, transactions and indexingReal-time sync and offline-first patterns in Flutter: local cache, queued writes and resolving conflicts when they syncProfiling and fixing performance issues on web and mobileNice to haveEvent-driven systems (message queues, event buses)Apps shipped to the Play Store or App StoreB2B SaaS or real-estate productsWhy join usJoin early enough that your decisions shape the platform behind a new way India's homes are marketed and sold. Dense workflows made simple, live data that has to be right, and a product built to be used every day by people who sell homes for a living. You'll work in a small team, close to the founder, where what you build ships.If that sounds like your kind of work, apply.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Job Description – Senior AI-Native Full Stack Engineer**

  
  
  

**Company:**
Nuaav

  

**Location:**
India / Remote / Hybrid

  

**Experience:**
4–7 Years

  

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

  
  
  

**Company Overview**

  
  
  

Nuaav is a boutique technology consulting firm focused on delivering innovative, scalable, and secure data engineering and AI solutions. We partner with corporate clients to drive impactful change through specialized expertise in product engineering, data systems, AI/ML, and user experience.

  
  
  

Our services emphasize personalized attention, agility, and quality, enabling clients to confidently transform and grow in evolving business environments.

  
  
  

**Role Overview**

  
  
  

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on
**AI-Native Full Stack Engineer**
with strong expertise in modern frontend and backend technologies, combined with proven experience building AI-powered applications and intelligent systems.

  
  
  

The ideal candidate is an AI-first engineer who can design, develop, and deploy scalable applications while leveraging Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI frameworks, and AI-assisted development tools.

  
  
  

This role requires strong end-to-end engineering ownership, from building responsive user interfaces and scalable backend services to integrating AI models, developing intelligent workflows, and deploying production-ready solutions.

  
  
  

We are looking for someone who has
**built real-world AI-native products**
, rather than someone whose experience is limited to consuming third-party AI APIs or using AI coding assistants.

  
  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  
  

**Full Stack Engineering**

  
  
  

  
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, high-performance full-stack applications.
  

  
  
  

  
* Build modern, responsive frontend applications using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
  

  
  
  

  
* Develop robust backend services using Python (FastAPI/Django) and/or Node.js (Express/NestJS).
  

  
  
  

  
* Design and integrate RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
  

  
  
  

  
* Work with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
  

  
  
  

  
* Own complete feature development, from architecture and frontend implementation to backend integration, testing, and production deployment.
  

  
  
  

**AI-Native & Generative AI Engineering**

  
  
  

  
* Design, build, and integrate AI-native capabilities into enterprise-grade applications.
  

  
  
  

  
* Develop production-ready applications leveraging LLMs such as OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, and other commercial or open-source models.
  

  
  
  

  
* Build and optimize
  **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**
  pipelines, including document ingestion, embeddings, vector search, and contextual retrieval.
  

  
  
  

  
* Develop AI agents, multi-step reasoning workflows, and tool-calling systems using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent technologies.
  

  
  
  

  
* Implement AI-driven automation, conversational interfaces, intelligent assistants, and workflow orchestration.
  

  
  
  

  
* Integrate AI capabilities into frontend experiences, including streaming responses, conversational UIs, real-time interactions, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
  

  
  
  

  
* Implement model evaluation, prompt optimization, guardrails, monitoring, and cost/performance optimization to ensure reliable AI applications.
  

  
  
  

  
* Design secure integrations between LLMs, enterprise data sources, APIs, and external tools.
  

  
  
  

**AI-Assisted Development & Engineering Practices**

  
  
  

  
* Actively leverage AI-native development environments such as
  **Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and MCP-based tooling**
  to accelerate engineering workflows.
  

  
  
  

  
* Apply AI-assisted development practices across code generation, debugging, refactoring, testing, and documentation while maintaining engineering quality.
  

  
  
  

  
* Build reusable components, establish development best practices, and contribute to technical architecture decisions.
  

  
  
  

  
* Develop unit, integration, and automated tests to ensure application reliability.
  

  
  
  

  
* Collaborate with product managers, AI engineers, designers, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into working solutions.
  

  
  
  

**Cloud & Deployment**

  
  
  

  
* Build and deploy cloud-native applications on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  

  
  
  

  
* Work with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, serverless technologies, and cloud infrastructure.
  

  
  
  

  
* Ensure application security, scalability, observability, and production reliability.
  

  
  
  

  
* Troubleshoot performance bottlenecks across frontend, backend, and AI inference layers.
  

  
  
  

**Required Qualifications**

  
  
  

  
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  

  
  
  

  
* 4+
  **years of hands-on software engineering experience**
  with strong full-stack development expertise.
  

  
  
  

  
* Proven experience building and deploying
  **AI-native or Generative AI applications in production**
  .
  

  
  
  

  
* Strong frontend expertise in React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  

  
  
  

  
* Strong backend development experience with Python and/or Node.js.
  

  
  
  

  
* Experience designing REST APIs, backend services, microservices, and integrating third-party systems.
  

  
  
  

  
* Strong working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and NoSQL technologies.
  

  
  
  

  
* Practical experience integrating LLM APIs and implementing AI-powered application features.
  

  
  
  

  
* Hands-on experience with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and AI orchestration frameworks.
  

  
  
  

  
* Understanding of agentic workflows, tool/function calling, and AI application architecture.
  

  
  
  

  
* Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
  

  
  
  

  
* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, Docker, testing frameworks, and modern software development practices.
  

  
  
  

  
* Hands-on familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or MCP integrations.
  

  
  
  

  
* Strong debugging, problem-solving, communication, and end-to-end ownership skills.
  

  
  
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  
  
  

  
* Experience developing Agentic AI systems or multi-agent workflows using LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar frameworks.
  

  
  
  

  
* Knowledge of vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS, or pgvector.
  

  
  
  

  
* Experience implementing LLM evaluations, monitoring, guardrails, and production observability.
  

  
  
  

  
* Familiarity with structured outputs, function calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and AI tool integrations.
  

  
  
  

  
* Experience with WebSockets, streaming APIs, and real-time AI-enabled interfaces.
  

  
  
  

  
* Exposure to AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or managed AI infrastructure.
  

  
  
  

  
* Experience developing enterprise SaaS products, AI platforms, or intelligent automation solutions.
  

  
  
  

  
* Understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, and secure handling of sensitive data.
  

  
  
  

  
* Experience working in agile, fast-paced product engineering or consulting environments.
  

  
  
  

**What Makes You a Strong Fit?**

  
  
  

  
* You are equally comfortable building sophisticated frontend interfaces and architecting reliable backend systems.
  

  
  
  

  
* You have
  **personally built and shipped AI-powered applications**
  , not just experimented with LLM APIs.
  

  
  
  

  
* You understand how to move AI solutions from proof of concept to scalable, production-ready products.
  

  
  
  

  
* You actively use AI-native development tools to improve engineering productivity without compromising code quality.
  

  
  
  

  
* You take ownership of entire features and can independently solve complex engineering problems.
  

  
  
  

  
* You enjoy working at the intersection of software engineering, AI, and product innovation.
  

  
  
  

**Why Work at Nuaav?**

  
  
  

  
* Work on cutting-edge AI-native, Generative AI, and Agentic AI applications.
  

  
  
  

  
* Gain hands-on exposure to enterprise-scale product engineering and cloud technologies.
  

  
  
  

  
* Collaborate with experienced engineers, AI specialists, and technology leaders.
  

  
  
  

  
* Be part of a fast-growing boutique consulting environment that values innovation, agility, and technical ownership.
  

  
  
  

  
* Opportunity to build impactful AI-driven products and contribute to next-generation intelligent systems.
  

  
  
  

**Interested candidates can share their profiles at candida.dsouza@nuaav.com**

title: Product Engineer – Java
description:
**Product Engineer – Java (2 Positions)**

📍 Location: Noida, India (Work from Office)

**MANDATORY APPLICATION REQUIREMENT**

Please send your resume and a short cover letter to hiring@runn.tv.
**Only applications received at this email ID will be considered for evaluation**
. Candidates applying only through LinkedIn will not be considered.
Candidates must have a maximum of 3 years of experience

.

**About the Role**

We are looking for highly skilled Product Engineers – Java with up to 3 years of experience to join the engineering team at RunnTV. We have 2 open positions for engineers who are passionate about building scalable, high-performance products and solving real-world technology challenges.

You will work on the technology powering RunnTV's OTT streaming platform and PlayStudio, our media technology platform, building backend services, APIs and scalable systems that support millions of users and a growing streaming ecosystem.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of meaningful engineering challenges, work closely with product and business teams, and contribute directly to building products in a fast-growing media and technology company.

**Preference will be given to candidates from premier engineering institutions, including IITs, NITs and other reputed engineering colleges.**

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Backend Development: Design, develop, test and deploy robust, scalable backend solutions using Java and related technologies.
2. Microservices & API Development: Build and maintain scalable microservices and RESTful APIs for seamless integration across our platforms.
3. Performance Optimization: Improve application performance, reduce latency and ensure high availability and reliability.
4. Database Management: Design, optimize and maintain SQL and NoSQL databases, ensuring data integrity and scalability.
5. Product Engineering: Work on features and services that power our OTT streaming platform and media technology products.
6. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, business and engineering teams to translate requirements into effective technical solutions.
7. Code Quality: Follow clean coding practices, write maintainable code and contribute to code reviews and automated testing.
8. CI/CD & Deployment: Participate in build, deployment and release processes, using modern development and DevOps practices.
9. Troubleshooting & Debugging: Identify and resolve technical issues, investigate root causes and improve system reliability.
10. Continuous Improvement: Explore new technologies, improve existing systems and contribute to engineering best practices.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

1. 1–3 years of relevant software development experience, with strong proficiency in Java.
2. Strong understanding of Core Java, OOP concepts and data structures.
3. Hands-on experience with Spring Boot, Hibernate and RESTful APIs.
4. Understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems.
5. Experience working with SQL and/or NoSQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or Redis.
6. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP or Azure.
7. Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
8. Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes is desirable.
9. Knowledge of multithreading, caching, performance optimization and message brokers such as Kafka or RabbitMQ is an advantage.
10. Strong problem-solving, analytical and debugging skills.
11. Ability to write clean, efficient and maintainable code.
12. A strong sense of ownership, willingness to learn and ability to work in a fast-paced product engineering environment.

Prior experience in media, OTT or streaming technology is an added advantage, but not mandatory.

**How to Apply**

If you are a passionate Java engineer who wants to build impactful products, solve challenging engineering problems and grow with a high-growth technology company, we would love to hear from you.

Send your resume and a short cover letter to: hiring@runn.tv

**Subject Line:**
Application – Product Engineer (Java)

**Please note:**
This is a Work from Office role based in Noida. We are hiring for 2 positions, and candidates with a maximum of 3 years of relevant experience are eligible to apply.

**About RunnTV**

RunnTV (runn.tv) is India's first independent and fastest-growing FAST (Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television) platform, delivering free entertainment to Indian audiences through 24x7 thematic and curated channels.

We are building RunnTV with a vision to create the biggest free entertainment experience destination for Indians across the globe.

RunnTV has eMedia Investments, South Africa, as its strategic investor and is in a high-growth phase across its consumer streaming platform and media technology business, with a bold vision towards 2030.

title: AI Architect
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and consultative
**AI Architect**
to help clients understand, shape, and activate the potential of AI in their business. This role owns the architecture of the AI solutions we propose — across pursuits, not just within one — and is accountable for the technical credibility of what we commit to.
  
  
You will partner with sales, industry specialists, engineering, and client executives to turn priority AI use cases into architectures that are demonstrable in weeks and defensible at enterprise scale: secure, cost-aware, evaluable, and buildable by the delivery teams that inherit them.
  
  
It is deliberately a
**hands-on architect**
role. You will still open the IDE, still build the hard part of the prototype, and still debug an agent that reasons badly — while setting the patterns, guardrails, and reference architectures that everyone else builds on.
  
  
AI/Gen AI/Gen AI
  
  
Shape demand and executive conviction
  
  

* Lead discovery and architecture workshops with client business and technology leadership; set the agenda rather than respond to it.
* Identify pain points, value levers, and high-impact AI opportunities, and sequence them into a pragmatic AI roadmap (quick wins → platform investments).
* Translate ambiguous, complex client questions into solution hypotheses, target-state architecture, and a phased path to get there.
* Build AI scenarios and value frameworks that illustrate meaningful business transformation, with measurable outcomes and a defensible business case.

Own the architecture
  
  

* Own end-to-end architecture: LLM and model-portfolio selection, context engineering, retrieval and knowledge architecture, agent orchestration, microservices, integrations, data platform touchpoints, and UI.
* Set the non-functional bar and design to it — latency, throughput, unit cost per interaction, accuracy/eval thresholds, observability, safety, security, data residency, and auditability.
* Define reference architectures, agentic blueprints, and accelerator standards for the practice; govern their reuse so pursuits start at 40% rather than zero.
* Make and document build-vs-buy and platform decisions, including model routing, fine-tuning vs prompting vs retrieval, and open vs proprietary model strategy.

Prove it
  
  

* Build prototypes, storyboards, demos, accelerators, and reusable agentic blueprints — personally on the critical path, and through the FDE pod for the rest.
* Engineer and validate AI agents for reliability, reasoning, safety, and performance; establish the evaluation and red-teaming approach that lets us state quality claims with evidence.
* Lead PoCs, pilots, and phase-0 MVPs across industries, arbitrating scope so the proof lands inside the sales cycle.

Win and hand over
  
  

* Author and quality-gate client-ready content: architecture decks, SoWs, proposals, estimates, value frameworks, risk and assumption registers, and demo storylines.
* Lead technical deep-dives, security and architecture reviews, and competitive differentiation discussions; handle the hardest objections in the room.
* Refine solution narratives based on client feedback and market conditions.
* Oversee a seamless transition from sales to delivery — architecture decision records, working code, known risks, and continuity of the people involved.

Build the practice
  
  

* Create thought leadership and reusable IP; represent the firm externally at client forums, partner events, and in published material.
* Mentor AI Leads and engineering teams; grow the bench of people who can do this role.
* Collaborate with hyperscalers and product partners to craft next-generation AI-led experiences and co-funded initiatives.

**Must-have Skills And Experience**
**Architecture and platform depth**

* Proven track record architecting and shipping production-grade GenAI/agentic systems in enterprise environments — not only pilots.
* Deep command of LLM selection and evaluation, context engineering, model routing and cost control, and the trade-offs between prompting, retrieval, tool use, and fine-tuning.
* Strong microservices and integration architecture: event-driven and API-led patterns, identity and access, secrets, multi-tenancy, and integration with core enterprise systems.
* Enterprise concerns as first-class design inputs: security, privacy, data residency, model governance, responsible AI, and regulatory constraints.

**Agentic AI engineering (hands-on)**

* Hands-on working knowledge of defining and configuring prompts, instructions, tools, reasoning strategies, guardrails, memory, and orchestration in AI agent development.
* Design and debugging of multi-agent and long-horizon workflows, including failure modes, recovery, and human-in-the-loop control points.
* Strong experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, tokenization, and prompt engineering — including retrieval evaluation and knowledge-freshness strategy.

**Engineering craft (hands-on)**

* Hands-on experience creating and maintaining Python libraries; working command of LangChain (or equivalent orchestration frameworks), Hugging Face, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, and locally hosted open models.
* Very strong experience developing RESTful APIs in Python with FastAPI (or similar) and integrating third-party services, UI components, and APIs.
* Hands-on Docker-based deployment, CI/CD, and disciplined use of Git/GitHub for source control and review — mandatory.
* Working knowledge of modern data platforms and their GenAI surfaces (Databricks, Snowflake Cortex, lakehouse patterns).

**Model Provider And Hyperscaler GenAI Platform Know-how**
  
  

* Broad, current understanding of the GenAI offerings across the major frontier-model providers and hyperscalers, with deep, hands-on mastery of at least one — deep enough to design on it, defend it in a client architecture review, and know where it breaks:

+ Anthropic — Claude model family, Claude API, tool use and extended thinking, Claude Agent SDK, MCP (Model Context Protocol) as an integration standard, Claude delivered via Amazon Bedrock / Vertex AI, and enterprise deployment and governance patterns.
+ OpenAI — GPT model family, Responses/Assistants APIs, Agents SDK, function calling, structured outputs, fine-tuning, batch and realtime APIs, enterprise data-handling commitments.
+ AWS — Amazon Bedrock (multi-model access, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Agents/AgentCore), SageMaker, and integration with AWS data, identity and security services.
+ Google — Gemini model family, Vertex AI (Model Garden, grounding, agent tooling, evaluation), and Gemini enterprise offerings.
+ Microsoft Azure — Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, AI Agent Service, AI Search for retrieval, and Azure-native identity, networking and compliance patterns.

* Able to construct and defend a multi-provider model strategy: capability-to-task mapping, model routing and tiering, benchmark and eval evidence, context-window and latency envelopes, unit economics, rate limits and capacity planning, deprecation and version-migration risk.
* Fluent in the enterprise decision criteria that actually settle these choices — data residency and sovereignty, tenant isolation, IP and training-data commitments, certifications and auditability, regional availability, and the client's existing cloud and licensing commitments.
* Designs for portability where it matters: provider-abstracted interfaces, gateway/routing layers, and prompt and eval assets that survive a model or vendor change, without over-abstracting to the point of losing provider-specific capability.
* Keeps pace with a fast-moving field and translates new releases into concrete client opportunity, filtering hype from what is production-ready.

**Consultative and commercial ability**

* Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business problems into crisp AI use cases with clear value hypotheses and measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication and articulation skills; credible with a CIO/CDO and with a client's principal engineer in the same day.
* Commercial fluency: estimation, deal shaping, pricing implications of architecture choices, and the discipline to say no to a use case that will not survive contact with production.
* Hands-on prototyping mindset — able to quickly build functional demos, agent workflows, or LLM-powered interactions that accelerate client conviction.

Good to have
  
  

* Prior experience in a pre-sales, consulting, solution-architecture, or forward-deployed engineering capacity at scale.
* Recognised depth in one or more industry domains (BFSI, healthcare/life sciences, retail/CPG, manufacturing, telecom, energy).
* Experience running partner-funded or co-innovation programmes with a hyperscaler or model provider (AWS, Microsoft, Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, NVIDIA or ISV partners), including funding programmes, early-access participation, and joint go-to-market.
* Certification on a hyperscaler AI/ML or architect track, or equivalent demonstrable platform depth.
* Experience with self-hosted / open-weight model deployment (vLLM, Bedrock or Vertex custom endpoints, on-prem GPU) for clients with strict data-boundary requirements.
* Published thought leadership, patents, open-source contributions, or conference speaking on GenAI/agentic systems.

title: Digital Systems Lead – Construction Site Apps
description:
About us

KV Developers is part of ReaRCo, a restructuring and turnaround group that works on practical solutions to real-world problems. We are building a technology-driven construction company and are developing a range of in-house digital tools for our projects, starting at our residential project in Greater Noida West.

About the role

Our site already runs on in-house mobile apps for snagging and de-snagging of flats, daily monitoring of works, labour and contractors, and reports for management, built on Google Workspace and AppSheet with scripted automation. More tools will follow.

We are looking for one person to own the day-to-day running of these apps: making changes, keeping the data clean, testing before release, training site staff and contractors, and making sure the apps are actually used on site. You will work directly with the founder and the project leadership. Most technical design and coding is prepared with AI tools; your job is to turn decisions into working, well-tested tools quickly and get them adopted on site.

What you will do

- Configure and release changes to the apps (AppSheet) and their data (Google Sheets); keep a change log.

- Own master data: users and logins, roles, contractors, locations, work items and assignments.

- Test every change on a test copy before release, and run field tests with site teams.

- Train engineers, foremen, contractors and vendors in Hindi and English, and follow up until the apps are used daily.

- Track adoption and data quality, and send a short written summary each evening.

- Collect feedback from site and management into one list, and prepare specifications with AI tools for decisions.

- Act as second administrator for Google Workspace and related accounts; keep access, backups and documentation in order.

- Support a planned move of the data to a SQL database with a senior technical reviewer.

What we are looking for

- 4 to 8 years in residential or commercial construction as a civil, QA/QC or planning engineer, or a no-code developer with real site exposure.

- Confident with Google Sheets and at least one no-code or low-code tool (AppSheet preferred); able to read simple scripts.

- Comfortable working with AI tools (for example ChatGPT or Claude) to draft, check and document work.

- Methodical about testing, data and documentation.

- Fluent in Hindi and English; able to train site staff and hold contractors to a routine.

- Discreet with confidential data and systems.

Good to have: Apps Script or JavaScript, SQL, Looker Studio, MS Project or Primavera, experience rolling out a site app or ERP module.

Location and hours: at our site in Greater Noida West, Monday to Saturday; hybrid once the rollout settles.

Reports to: the founder, working closely with the project head on site and the planning head.

Compensation: competitive, in line with experience.

To apply: please include one example of a tool, app, sheet or process you built or rolled out, and what changed as a result.

title: Microsoft -Pure AI -Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI Business Solutions – AI Engineer Senior:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a skilled AI Engineer (Senior Consultant) to design, develop, and deploy intelligent agent-based solutions leveraging Microsoft AI technologies. This role focuses on building scalable AI-driven applications and enhancing enterprise processes through automation and innovation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop AI-driven solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and agent-based frameworks.
* Build, test, and deploy intelligent agents using Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel (Python or C#).
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions within enterprise systems and workflows.
* Translate business requirements into scalable AI architectures and reusable components.
* Ensure solution performance, reliability, and alignment with enterprise security and governance standards.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Design and develop AI-driven solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and agent-based frameworks.
* Build, test, and deploy intelligent agents using Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel (Python or C#).
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions within enterprise systems and workflows.
* Translate business requirements into scalable AI architectures and reusable components.
* Ensure solution performance, reliability, and alignment with enterprise security and governance standards.
* Ability to work effectively in distributed, onshore–offshore delivery models.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* The following skills are preferred and add value to the role:
* Experience with Power Platform.
* Experience with Azure Integration Services.
* Experience supporting large transformation or digital modernization programs
* Familiarity with testing tools, deployment cycles, and release management practices
* Experience working across multiple industries or complex business environments

**What We Look For**

* Total Experience: [4+ Years]
* Relevant Experience (AI/Agent-based solutions): 1+ Years
* Prior experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise delivery engagements.
* Degree in BE / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or equivalent with relevant industry experience.

Oxford University Press is seeking an Analyst, DPM to support the development, enhancement, and delivery of innovative digital products that help advance learning and educational outcomes. This is an excellent opportunity for a technology-focused professional who is passionate about digital product development and enjoys working in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.

As part of the Digital Product Management team, you will play an important role in supporting the development, customization, release, and maintenance of digital products. As Analyst, DPM, you will support the delivery of digital products throughout their lifecycle, ensuring high-quality user experiences and timely product releases.

Key responsibilities include:

* Supporting the development of new products, product features, and innovative ideas, including building quick MVPs to help stakeholders visualize product concepts.

* Ensuring User Manuals, FAQs, Help Videos, and related support materials are maintained, updated, and of a high standard.
* Ensuring compliance requirements, NDA obligations, and third-party processes are followed in accordance with group guidelines.
* Coordinating effectively with Editorial, Marketing, Customer Support, Finance teams, and third-party vendor partners.

  Impact

This role is critical in ensuring OUP's digital products are delivered efficiently, maintained to high standards, and continually improved to meet customer needs. By supporting product development, content delivery, quality assurance, and stakeholder collaboration, you will help drive successful product launches, improved customer experiences, and operational excellence across OUP's digital portfolio.

  About You Essential Criteria

* B.Tech or MCA in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3-4 years of IT experience.
* At least 1 year of experience in product development, product management, or project delivery roles.
* Experience in digital product creation, development, implementation, and execution.
* Experience working within the EdTech, K-12, or Publishing domain.
* Experience supporting cloud-enabled and web-enabled solutions, including web and app-based products.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Proven ability to coordinate with third-party suppliers and delivery partners.
* Self-motivated, creative, dedicated, and able to work independently.
* High level of integrity and ownership.

Desirable Criteria

* Experience working within agile product development environments.
* Exposure to QA, UAT, release management, and product lifecycle management.
* Experience managing customer-facing digital products and implementations.
* Understanding of digital content workflows and learning technologies.
* Experience developing product documentation, training materials, and support resources.
* Knowledge of educational publishing and digital learning solutions.

Please contact 
**shariq.anwar@oup.com**
with any queries relating to this role. To ensure a smooth application process, please submit your CV through this link than via email.

title: IoT Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced
**IoT Engineer**
with 2–5 years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, integrating, and deploying end-to-end IoT solutions.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working across
**IoT devices, sensors, embedded systems, communication protocols, APIs, cloud platforms, databases, and backend systems**
to build reliable IoT solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Design, develop, integrate, and deploy end-to-end IoT solutions.

• Work with IoT devices, sensors, actuators, microcontrollers, and edge devices.

• Develop solutions using ESP32, ESP8266, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, STM32, or equivalent platforms.

• Implement communication using MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, BLE, Wi-Fi, Modbus, and other IoT protocols.

• Develop reliable device-to-cloud communication and data transmission.

• Integrate IoT devices with REST APIs, backend services, databases, and cloud platforms.

• Work with AWS IoT, Azure IoT, Google Cloud, or equivalent platforms.

• Develop and maintain IoT data pipelines for collecting, processing, and storing device data.

• Develop or integrate IoT monitoring dashboards for device status, sensor data, alerts, and performance.

• Troubleshoot hardware, firmware, connectivity, network, API, and data-related issues.

• Perform testing, debugging, validation, and deployment of IoT devices and applications.

• Monitor deployed devices and identify connectivity, performance, and data accuracy issues.

• Implement device authentication, secure communication, and basic IoT security practices.

• Work with Linux-based systems and edge computing environments.

• Maintain technical documentation related to IoT architecture, devices, APIs, configurations, and deployments.

• Collaborate with backend, software, AI/ML, and operations teams.

• Evaluate new IoT technologies and recommend suitable hardware, protocols, and platforms.

**Required Skills & Experience**

• 2–5 years of professional experience in IoT development or integration.

• Strong understanding of IoT architecture and device-to-cloud communication.

• Hands-on experience with ESP32, ESP8266, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, STM32, or equivalent platforms.

• Strong knowledge of MQTT and REST APIs.

• Good understanding of TCP/IP, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, and HTTP/HTTPS.

• Programming experience in Python, C/C++, or Embedded C.

• Hands-on experience with sensors, actuators, GPIO, UART, SPI, I2C, and serial communication.

• Experience with MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or equivalent databases.

• Experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, or another cloud platform.

• Good understanding of Linux and command-line tools.

• Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Good to Have**

• AWS IoT Core or Azure IoT Hub experience.

• Experience with LoRaWAN, Zigbee, NB-IoT, 4G/5G, or cellular IoT.

• Experience with Node-RED, Grafana, or similar monitoring platforms.

• Experience with edge computing and Raspberry Pi/Linux-based gateways.

• Knowledge of Docker and containerized deployments.

• Understanding of IoT security, authentication, encryption, and secure communication.

• Experience with OTA firmware updates and device management.

• Exposure to Edge AI / AI at the Edge.

• Experience in industrial IoT, logistics, asset tracking, fleet monitoring, or supply-chain applications.

**Education**

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, IoT, or a related field.

• Strong hands-on IoT project experience will be considered an advantage.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate should be able to independently understand and implement the complete IoT flow:

**Sensor/Device → Embedded System → Connectivity → MQTT/API → Edge/Cloud → Backend → Database → Dashboard/Alerts**

The candidate should be comfortable working across
**hardware, firmware, networking, cloud, and software integration**
, rather than focusing on only one component.

**Key Skills**

IoT | MQTT | ESP32 | Raspberry Pi | Arduino | Python | C/C++ | Embedded Systems | Sensors | REST APIs | AWS | Azure | GCP | TCP/IP | Wi-Fi | BLE | Modbus | Linux | Cloud | Databases | Edge Computing

* Mentor senior and mid-level engineers in architecture thinking, technical design, and distributed systems development.

**Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

* Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging architectures, and cloud technologies.

title: Full-Stack &  Ecom DevOps Engineer
description:
About MMV

MMV is building a D2C home for vinyl records, CDs, retro audio players and music collectibles, with label partners such as T-Series, Yash Raj and Tips. Our customers are collectors and music lovers in India and abroad. Our website (mallarmediaventures.com) is a custom Next.js build, and it is the single point where every campaign, drop and pre-booking converts into revenue. You will own it.

The role

You will own the codebase, hosting, deployment and stability of our storefront and backend. You will ship new features, keep the site fast on launch days and make sure every rupee of ad spend is tracked properly through to the order.

What you’ll do

**Product and development**

* Maintain and extend the Next.js/React storefront: catalogue, filters, search, wishlist, cart, checkout, user login and order tracking
* Build drop and pre-booking mechanics: pre-book, special edition, limited stock, waitlist, back-in-stock alerts, bundles and gifting
* Build label and collection pages as we move from a few titles to a multi-label catalogue
* Build and maintain the admin and back-office tools for catalogue upload, inventory, orders and pricing
* Make the entry experience and page load fast without losing the brand feel

**Payments, orders and logistics**

* Own payment gateway integrations (UPI, cards, COD, international payments) and reduce failed payments
* Integrate shipping and courier partners, order-status updates and returns/refund flows
* Handle multi-currency and international shipping for buyers abroad
* Keep inventory accurate across the website, warehouse and pre-owned stock

**DevOps and reliability**

* Own cloud hosting, CI/CD, staging and production environments, domains, SSL and CDN
* Set up monitoring, alerts, logging, backups and a clear rollback process
* Make sure the site holds up during launches, influencer pushes and paid-ad surges
* Protect customer data and payments; follow DPDP and PCI-aware practices; manage bots and fraud

**Growth, tracking and SEO**

* Own tracking: GTM, GA4, Meta Pixel and Conversions API, Google Ads conversions, server-side tagging
* Make UTM and campaign attribution reliable so marketing can see true ROAS
* Fix technical SEO: metadata, sitemaps, structured product data, Core Web Vitals
* Build simple dashboards: sessions, logins, add-to-cart, checkout drop-offs, sales by title and by label
* Support A/B tests and landing pages with the marketing team

**Customer communication**

* Integrate WhatsApp, email and SMS flows: order updates, abandoned-cart reminders, pre-booking confirmations and drop alerts

What we’re looking for

**Must have**

* 3–6 years of full-stack experience with strong Next.js, React, TypeScript and Node.js, ecom platform development
* Experience with a SQL or NoSQL database (PostgreSQL, MySQL or MongoDB) and REST APIs
* Hands-on DevOps: AWS, GCP or Vercel, Docker, CI/CD, CDN (Cloudflare), basic Linux
* Experience with payment gateways (Razorpay, PayU, Stripe or similar) and shipping integrations
* Working knowledge of GA4, GTM and Meta Conversions API
* Ownership mindset: comfortable running production, handling issues and staying calm on launch day

**Good to have**

* D2C, pre-order, limited-drop or collectibles experience
* Cross-border e-commerce: multi-currency, duties, international couriers
* Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, load testing
* CRM or automation tools (WebEngage, CleverTap, Klaviyo) and WhatsApp Business API
* A love for music, vinyl or collecting

Key outcomes (first 6–12 months)

* Site uptime of 99.9% or better, including launch days
* Higher checkout and payment success rates
* Mobile page load under 3 seconds
* Accurate server-side conversion tracking across Meta and Google
* Multi-label catalogue and pre-booking flows running smoothly
* Registered users and repeat purchase tools live

What we offer

* Real ownership of a growing, brand-led D2C platform
* Direct access to leadership and the marketing team
* A product people are emotionally attached to
* Salary: As per industry trends, plus performance incentive

How to apply

Send your CV, GitHub or portfolio, and one e-commerce project you’re proud of to sachin@mallarmediaventures.com

description: Experience: 8+ yearsStacks: React/TypeScript, .NET Core, Java, GoThe roleWe need a true full-stack engineer who owns a feature from the database schema through the API to the interface a user clicks and does not hand off at the boundary. Our platform runs services in four languages, so the work regularly crosses a language line mid-problem. You will write code most days, review a lot of it, lead the design of medium-sized features, and be the person a mid-level engineer asks when something fails in production in a way the logs do not immediately explain.Stack proficiencyWe are not looking for expert-level depth in all four backend languages. What we need is:· Strong proficiency in the front-end stack — React and TypeScript, in production, at a level where you make architectural calls rather than follow patterns.· Strong proficiency in at least one backend language — .NET Core, Java or Go.· A genuine willingness to learn the others. You read unfamiliar code without flinching, and you expect to be useful in a second backend language within a quarter.Depth in two backend languages is a real advantage, not a requirement.Hard skills· Languages: React + TypeScript (strict mode, typed API clients). Then one or more of: ASP.NET Core / C# with EF Core; Spring Boot / JVM; idiomatic Go with goroutines and context.· Architecture: Clean architecture or hexagonal, dependency inversion, clear service boundaries. REST API design with OpenAPI contracts. Event-driven patterns — queues, idempotency, retries with backoff. Judgment about when a pattern is overkill.· Databases: Strong PostgreSQL — schema and index design, reading EXPLAIN ANALYZE, transactions and isolation levels, versioned migrations. Redis for caching.· AWS: Production experience with ECS/EKS or Lambda, RDS, S3, SQS/SNS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, IAM least privilege. Terraform or CDK.· Containers: Docker including multi-stage builds. Working Kubernetes knowledge— deployments, config and secrets, resource limits, debugging a pod that will not stay up.· CI/CD: Pipelines you have built and maintained (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps). Trunk-based development, tests as a real merge gate, migrations in the deploy path, blue/green or canary rollout with a rollback you have used.· Observability: Structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry.· Security: OWASP Top 10, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, JWT, role- and attribute-based access control, secrets out of source control.· Testing: Unit, integration against real dependencies (Testcontainers), and contract tests between services.· Git and agile: Rebasing, bisecting, clean commit history. Comfortable in Scrum or Kanban — refinement, story slicing, honest estimation.AI toolingWe use AI coding tools daily and expect the same from this role.· Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or equivalent — used on real production work, not just tried once.· The judgment to review AI output critically. Stand-ups, design discussions, incident calls and code review all happen in English, daily, with a distributed team. You need to be able to disagree with a colleague about an architectural decision in real time, on a call, and be understood precisely.· Strong written communication. Pull request descriptions, design documents and status updates that a reader in another time zone can act on without a follow-up meeting.· Autonomy.  We're looking for a Founding Full Stack Developer to join our core engineering team.
 



 This is an opportunity to work closely with the founding team and play a key role in building scalable web applications, AI\-powered products, and internal platforms from the ground up. While this role is primarily focused on frontend development using React.js and Next.js, you'll also contribute to backend development and collaborate across the full application stack.
 



 The ideal candidate is a self\-driven engineer who enjoys building products end\-to\-end, embraces modern AI development workflows, and takes ownership from idea to deployment.

* Develop modern web applications using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3\.

* Develop reusable components and maintain clean, scalable architecture.
* Collaborate on backend development using Node.js, Express.js, or similar technologies.
* Design, integrate, and consume REST APIs and third\-party services.
* Build and integrate AI\-powered features into web applications.
* Utilize AI\-powered development tools to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, documentation, and overall productivity.
* Collaborate with designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to deliver high\-quality products.
* Optimize applications for performance, scalability, security, and maintainability.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies, AI frameworks, and modern development practices.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* 2\+ years of professional experience in software development.
* Strong proficiency in React.js and Next.js.
* Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6\+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3\.
* Working knowledge of backend development using Node.js, Express.js, or similar technologies.
* Understanding of REST APIs, databases, authentication, and modern web architecture.
* Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Hands\-on experience using AI\-powered development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, Roo Code, or similar AI coding assistants.
* Working knowledge of AI application development, including LLM integrations, AI agents, prompt engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and AI APIs.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to work independently and take ownership.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, and deployment pipelines.
* Experience building SaaS platforms, dashboards, or AI\-powered applications.
* Understanding of scalable software architecture and security best practices.
* Passion for learning emerging technologies and AI innovations.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 We're looking for someone who is:
 


* Passionate about building products from the ground up.
* A strong React developer with working knowledge of backend development.
* Excited about AI\-powered software development and modern engineering practices.
* Self\-driven, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership.
* A fast learner who adapts quickly to new technologies.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment.
* Focused on writing clean, scalable, and maintainable code.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Opportunity to be a founding member of our engineering team.
* Work on cutting\-edge AI\-powered products and modern web applications.
* Exposure to domestic and international client projects.
* A collaborative, innovation\-driven, and AI\-first engineering culture.
* Continuous learning, mentorship, and rapid career growth.
* The freedom to experiment, innovate, and make a real impact from day one.



  





**Additional Information** 




 Digidel Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where innovation, ownership, and continuous learning are valued.

description:

**SCT\-Tech Enablement \- Manager**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking a talented and experienced Supply Chain Lead (FDE) with 9–12 years of experience to join our growing Digital Supply Chain Team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications across both front\-end and back\-end layers. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative digital solutions that drive business value and enhance user experiences.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy full\-stack web applications using modern front\-end and back\-end technologies.
* Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces using frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Develop robust server\-side applications, APIs, and microservices using technologies such as Node.js, .NET, Java, or Python.
* Design and optimize relational and non\-relational databases to ensure performance, scalability, and data integrity.
* Integrate applications with internal and external systems through RESTful APIs and event\-driven architectures.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design sessions to ensure adherence to best practices.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across development, testing, and production environments.
* Implement security, performance optimization, and monitoring practices across the application landscape.
* Contribute to CI/CD implementation, DevOps practices, and cloud\-native development initiatives.
* Mentor junior developers and support knowledge\-sharing across teams.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 6–10 years of hands\-on experience in full\-stack application development.
* Strong proficiency in front\-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js and Microsoft 365 technologies like PowerApps.
* Experience in back\-end development using one or more technologies such as Node.js, .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, or Python.
* Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and API integration patterns.
* Experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.).
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Experience in development of Responsive UI components for Agentic AI / RAG based applications

* Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to serverless architectures and event\-driven application design.
* Experience working with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar deployment tools.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and test\-driven development practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled development tools and modern engineering productivity practices.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to technical standards and reusable frameworks.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Mercer Tech at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Gurugram. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
   

  

 As a
 **Lead Software Developer** 
 at Mercer, you will play a key role in shaping our future in the rapidly evolving field of, scalable Shared Services that incorporate AI capabilities. Collaboration is essential, as you will work within a team that follows Scaled Agile methodologies. We are seeking a self\-motivated and delivery\-focused individual with a strong technology background, where experience in AI integrations and prompt engineering will be advantageous, to help us grow our talent and drive innovation in this exciting sector.
   

  

**We will count on you to:**
* Ensure Shared Service requirements are gathered accurately, fully understood, and communicated clearly to all stakeholders, with transparency on impacts and dependencies.
* Design, develop, and support secure, scalable backend and frontend services using Phyton, Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
* Implement authentication and security solutions leveraging JWT, SAML/OIDC, Okta integration, Microsoft EntraID and Passport / Passport\-SAML concepts.
* Build and maintain data persistence layers using Postgresql, MongoDB and Mongoose to deliver robust and reliable application functionality.
* Develop automated tests and support quality assurance practices using Jest, NestJS testing patterns, class\-validator, and class\-transformer. Including documentation, and usage guidance to ensure shared services are easy to adopt, maintain, and support.
* Integrate applications using Express, including body\-parser and cookie\-parser, and work effectively with NestJS guards, hooks, modules, and dependency injection.
* Use Git, npm ecosystem, and environment configuration management effectively to support local development, testing, and delivery.
* Write high\-quality, maintainable code aligned to Agile user stories and established engineering standards, while leveraging AI development productivity tools such as GitHub Copilot where appropriate.
* Troubleshoot and resolve development and integration issues, with a focus on performance, authentication, and service interoperability.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, serving as a role model and supporting their growth within the team.
* Collaborate with peers to foster a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and engineering excellence.
* Champion Agile practices that support effective product delivery and strong team collaboration.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with product owners, solutions architects, analysts, and leadership to ensure alignment of technical solutions with business objectives.
* Leverage emerging technologies, including AI, to solve real\-world challenges and enhance our software solutions.
* Provide technical support to consumers of the Shared Services for existing issues and recommend enhancements to current solutions.


**What is in it for you?**
* Chance to work on enterprise\-grade shared services used by multiple teams (high visibility and impact).
* Exposure to AI integrations and prompt engineering (advantageous/valued experience).
* Work with modern engineering practices: cloud\-native architecture, CI/CD, DevOps quality gates, security\-first delivery.
* A culture of continuous improvement, learning, and knowledge sharing, with scope to grow as a technical leader.


**What you need to have:**
 We are seeking candidates with a proven track record in developing multiple products/services, ideally those that incorporate AI technologies. The ideal candidate will possess:
   

  

* Shared Services Mindset: Demonstrates a strong focus on building reusable components and services that support multiple teams, reduce duplication, and improve consistency across the platform.
* Strong Communication Skills: Ability to effectively interact with both technical and non\-technical colleagues in a cross\-functional environment.
* Strong Self\-Starter and Team Contributor: A proactive individual who takes initiative in their work, embraces a model of continuous learning to stay updated with industry trends and technologies, and actively contributes to team success by collaborating effectively and sharing knowledge with colleagues.
* Diverse Software Delivery Experience: A successful history of delivering software across a variety of languages, technologies, and platforms, with familiarity in AI frameworks and libraries being a plus.
* Agile Methodologies: Experience with Agile at Scale, Lean, and Continuous Delivery methodologies to drive efficient development processes.
* Cloud\-Native Architecture Knowledge: Familiarity with cloud\-native software architectures, particularly in deploying solutions on platforms such as AWS and Microsoft Azure, with an interest in AI applications.
* Security\-Driven Design Practices: Understanding of security\-driven design principles and experience addressing SAST/DAST findings, especially in relation to AI data handling and model security.
* CI/CD and DevOps Proficiency: Proficiency in CI/CD and DevOps practices, including the use of Quality Gates to ensure high code quality.


**Technical Skills or Qualifications Required:**
* Extensive Programming Experience: Proven experience with multiple programming languages and frameworks, with deep expertise in at least one of the following: JavaScript, TypeScript. Familiarity with AI programming languages such as Python is a plus.
* Framework Proficiency: Strong experience with frameworks such as Nest.js, Express.js, and familiarity with AI frameworks like LangFlow or LangChain.
* Prompt Engineering Skills: Solid experience with engineering prompts to effectively interact with AI models, optimizing their performance and output for various applications.
* Testing Expertise: Proficient in Unit Testing and Integration Testing, including the ability to test AI solutions and their integrations effectively.
* Container Technologies: Experience with container technologies like Docker and Kubernetes, to enhance scalability and efficiency.
* Middleware Technologies: Familiarity with any of these middleware technologies such as Kafka, Camunda, Temporal, AWS Lambda Durable function, AWS Step Function and RabbitMQ is needed.
* Design and Development Practices: Demonstrated experience in refactoring, implementing design patterns, design\-driven development, continuous integration, and application security.
* SDLC Knowledge: Solid understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) processes and practices, with experience using tools such as SharePoint, ADO, and GitHub.
* Cloud Infrastructure Experience: Experience designing and deploying applications/shared services on cloud infrastructure with providers like AWS, including S3 storage.
* Stack Knowledge: Knowledge of the MEAN stack, with an interest in leveraging this technology for AI\-driven applications.
* Senior developer with 7\-11 years of experience in software development, solution design and development, plus delivering high\-quality technical projects/services.


**Why join our team:**
* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well\-being.

 **ServiceNow Senior Consultant**

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with consulting skills and enjoys solving complex business challenges through innovative platform development.

* Develop custom applications, workflows, integrations, and reusable components leveraging JavaScript, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Script Includes, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, and other platform capabilities.
* Configure and extend ServiceNow applications, including but not limited to ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, SPM, IRM, and custom applications based on client requirements.
* Develop and maintain REST and SOAP integrations with internal and third\-party enterprise systems.
* Design and optimize Service Catalog offerings, workflows, record producers, and self\-service experiences using Employee Center, Service Portal, and UI Builder.
* Build and support Workspace experiences, Next Experience components, and mobile capabilities.
* Design and maintain data models, CMDB structures, and Common Service Data Model (CSDM) relationships where applicable.
* Implement platform security using ACLs, application scoping, roles, and security best practices.
* Collaborate with solution architects and technical leads to develop scalable, maintainable, and upgrade\-friendly platform solutions.
* Translate business requirements into technical designs and implementation plans using Agile methodologies.
* Perform code reviews, troubleshoot complex platform issues, optimize performance, and support testing and deployment activities.
* Utilize source control, update set management, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps best practices to support application lifecycle management.
* Lead technical discussions, client workshops, and design sessions while providing guidance on ServiceNow platform capabilities and best practices.
* Produce clear technical documentation, development standards, and implementation artifacts.
* Mentor junior developers and contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes and coding standards.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of professional software development or platform engineering experience, including 2\+ years of hands\-on ServiceNow development experience.
* Experience designing, developing, and implementing enterprise solutions on the ServiceNow platform.
* Strong understanding of ServiceNow architecture, platform capabilities, and application development best practices.
* Experience working within Agile delivery methodologies.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and consulting skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong JavaScript development skills and proficiency with ServiceNow scripting APIs and development frameworks.
* Experience with Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, App Engine Studio, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspace development.
* Certifications in one of the following preferred:
+ ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
+ ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
+ One or more ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications (ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, SPM, IRM, or other product areas)
+ ITIL Foundation Certification

* Experience building and supporting REST/SOAP integrations and API\-based solutions.
* Knowledge of platform security, application scoping, ACLs, and governance best practices.
* Experience with CMDB, CSDM, Discovery, or Service Mapping is preferred.
* Familiarity with source control, Git, update sets, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
* Understanding of ITIL concepts and enterprise service management processes.
* Experience developing across multiple ServiceNow product areas is highly desirable.

title: Technical Lead
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Java Full Stack Technical Lead, you will be expected to work as a self\-driven individual contributor with strong ownership of end\-to\-end design, development, and delivery of product features across both backend and frontend layers. You should be hands\-on in Java\-based backend services, REST APIs, microservices, cloud\-native deployments, and modern frontend development using frameworks such as React or Angular. Along with independent technical contribution, the role requires mentoring junior engineers in the team, guiding implementation decisions, reviewing code, ensuring secure and high\-quality delivery, supporting customer escalations, and driving innovation through PoCs and continuous improvements.
   

  

**Job Requirement And Responsibilities**
* The Java Full Stack Technical Lead will be responsible for independently leading product feature development across backend and frontend layers, including design, implementation, validation, and delivery of scalable software applications and systems.
* The candidate should be hands\-on and technically strong enough to contribute as an individual contributor while also providing technical leadership, design direction, code reviews, and guidance to the team.
* Mandatory experience is required in both backend engineering using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, databases, and cloud\-native patterns, as well as frontend engineering using React or Angular, TypeScript/JavaScript, UI integration, and responsive web application development.
* You need to follow development processes and security processes, and will ensure the technical quality of the solution with UTs coverage and handle/identify security vulnerabilities.
* You will work on Customers escalated issues.
* You will get exposure to working on cutting\-edge technologies and innovation events.
* Drive innovation by proposing, prototyping, and evaluating new technical solutions (PoCs), and contribute to continuous improvements in performance, scalability, and developer productivity.
* Contribute innovative ideas for technical improvements and processes.
* Technologies should not be a constraint for the right person; however, strong hands\-on exposure to Java full stack development is mandatory. The role involves Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, React or Angular, TypeScript/JavaScript, Kubernetes, and ownership of deployments and chart definitions for our applications.


**Job Knowledge, Skill And Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics and Communication, or a related discipline, with 10\+ years of application development experience, including strong hands\-on Java full stack development across backend and frontend technologies.
* Strong hands\-on experience in designing and implementing REST API based backend applications using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot frameworks.
* Strong exposure to frontend technologies such as React or Angular is mandatory, with the ability to collaborate on UI architecture, review frontend implementation, and ensure seamless integration with backend services.
* Core knowledge in Data Structures, OOPS, Solid design principles, and common Design Patterns is must.
* Working exposure to any cloud stack (GCP, AWS) is must.
* Leveraging AI in routine work or personal POCs will be an added advantage.
* Exposure to Cloud and Kubernetes\-based applications will be an important factor.
* The ideal candidate should be technology\-agnostic, adaptable, and comfortable learning and working across different languages, frameworks, and platforms as required.
* Hands\-on experience with a modern cloud\-friendly programming language such as Python or Node.js. will be an added advantage.
* Experience in Unit Testing and any automation (BDD) framework will be nice to have.
* Good exposure to any relational database MSSQL or MySql.
* Exposure in Micro Services architecture and Docker based application will be an added advantage.


**What do we offer?**
 At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!
   

  

 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.
